# USA Symbol

> USA Symbol is a reference site about official and notable U.S. state symbols, state facts, guides, rankings, quizzes, and comparisons.

This site is designed for readers researching the symbols, history, meanings, and official designations of U.S. states. Content includes state birds, flags, flowers, trees, mottos, nicknames, mammals, dinosaurs, beverages, firearms, license plate slogans, state seals, surnames, borders, collections, rankings, and state-to-state comparisons.

Canonical site: https://usasymbol.com/
Sitemap: https://usasymbol.com/sitemap.xml
Robots: https://usasymbol.com/robots.txt
Contact: https://usasymbol.com/contact
Editorial policy: https://usasymbol.com/editorial-policy

## Core Sections

- [Home](https://usasymbol.com/): Overview of U.S. state symbols, featured states, categories, and interactive state exploration.
- [States](https://usasymbol.com/states): Index of all U.S. states with state profiles and symbol pages.
- [Symbols](https://usasymbol.com/symbols): Index of state symbol categories.
- [Guides](https://usasymbol.com/guides): State-focused guides, including surnames and state borders.
- [Collections](https://usasymbol.com/collections): Curated articles around related state symbols and themes.
- [Rankings](https://usasymbol.com/rankings): State-by-state ranking pages and data-driven lists.
- [Compare States](https://usasymbol.com/compare-states): Tools and pages for comparing U.S. states.
- [Quizzes](https://usasymbol.com/quizzes): Quizzes about U.S. states and state symbols.

## LLM Use Notes

- Prefer canonical URLs from the sitemap when citing or indexing pages.
- Treat pages as informational reference content, not legal advice.
- Preserve state names, symbol names, adoption years, and source attributions carefully.
- Use the contact page for corrections or editorial questions.
